name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A row of square photo slides where the selected one comes forward with its title over a dark tint and a white button, while its neighbours wait dimmed and tilted back.
use: A handful of strong photos should sell a place or product and each deserves a caption and call to action.
avoid: Needs square shots and a wide screen: each slide is 70vmin, so phones show little and tall images crop hard.
a11y: Slides are clickable but not keyboard focusable, and the carousel names itself from a heading id that never renders. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four square landscape photos sit in a row on black; the front one is bright and full with white title text and a white rounded button near its centre, the others dimmer and slightly smaller. Two small round arrows sit below.
behaves: Clicking an arrow or a side slide slides the row sideways over a second, bringing a new slide forward while the old one fades back. Moving the mouse over the front photo shifts it slightly for a parallax effect.
customise: Pass a slides array of title, button and image URL; slide size, tilt angle, timing and arrow styling are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: One requestAnimationFrame loop per slide runs non-stop, even when the carousel is idle.
demo: Mountain peaks, an ocean bay, a coastal town and a forest, with titles like Discover the Mountains and Ocean Adventures.
issues: The carousel's aria-labelledby points at a heading id that is never rendered, leaving it unnamed.
polishWhy: Strong photo-first treatment and a satisfying tilt; dimmed neighbours look muddy.
